note: Honeycomb's words, from wordfreq (Robyn Speer, CC-BY-SA 4.0, https://github.com/rspeer/wordfreq), pruned at build time by the LibreOffice Hunspell dictionaries (nothing of theirs is shipped) and the LDNOOBW list. Built by tools/build_honeycomb.py: folded words of four letters or more with no S and at most seven letters, each with its letter mask over `alphabet` and its tier (0 common .. 2 rarer: the band from which it is one of the day's words; 3 taken and scored, never counted or hinted). `written` keeps a word's accents by its index; `shy` are the indices of day's words the dictionaries also have as a name or a place: counted, never hinted.
